history.question: can you give me the Eligibility Criteria
history.answer:
Here are the Eligibility Criteria for the courses offered at ABC Institute of Technology:

* B.Tech:
	+ Must have passed 12th with Maths, Physics, and Chemistry with at least 45% marks (40% for reserved categories)
* M.Tech:
	+ Relevant B.Tech or BE degree
* MBA:
	+ Any bachelor degree with 50% marks
* MCA:
	+ Any bachelor degree with 50% marks
	+ Maths at 12th or degree level (for MCA)

history.question: Fee Structure
history.answer:
Here is the Fee Structure for the courses offered at ABC Institute of Technology:

* B.Tech:
	+ Tuition fee: Rs 95,000 per year
	+ One-time admission fee: Rs 10,000
	+ Caution deposit: Rs 5,000 (refundable at the end of the course)
	+ University and exam fee: Rs 4,000 per year
	+ Management quota B.Tech students: Rs 1,40,000 per year
* MBA and MCA:
	+ Fees not mentioned in the provided information.

Please note that the fee structure may be subject to change, and it's always best to check with the college office for the latest information. If you have any further questions, you can contact the college office at info@abcit.edu.in or 040-1234-5678.

history.question: hostel fee details
history.answer:

* Electricity:
	+ Electricity is included for standard use

history.question: What are the snacks timings in the Mess?
